freezeStatus: frozen before any fold-trained fit or candidate-layer score was computed
question: Is the neutral R assumption right for an ordinary same-party National/Labour incumbent replacement?
units: R is the Stage7 additive_national_centered normalizedPremium (fraction internally, percentage points in reports)

requires: R_old: Stage7 normalizedPremium of the outgoing source winner occurrence is finite
R_new: Stage7 normalizedPremium of the Stage51 primary target candidate occurrence is finite

extendedSensitivity.note: all election-time incumbent exits (Stage51: 60 across both scopes) with no tag exclusion

excludedByRule: scope maori (no Maori candidate layer; counted and listed, never fitted or scored)
primary-type rows carrying an excluded tag
rows lacking a finite R_old or R_new
sample.continuationReference: relation continuation, scope general, finite R_old and R_new: descriptive persistence slope only, never an arm
sample.layerScoringRequires: primary-sample target candidate present in the Stage44 candidate-layer inventory (general exact seats 2017, 2020, 2023), with centered R exactly 0 and supportedMass.R == 0 in the control (a successor with own R history keeps it and is counted and excluded)

foldNote: values are the target years whose replacements may train the fit; R_new of the held-out target year is never used

arms.C: control: incoming candidate neutral, R-hat_new = mu_f (centered zR = 0), as deployed
arms.K: constant: R-hat_new = a-hat, a-hat = equal-seat mean of training R_new (rho = 0)
arms.P: partial transfer: R-hat_new = a-hat + rho-hat * R_old; equal-seat least squares on training pairs, rho constrained to [0, 1], a re-solved at a bound
arms.T: reference only, never a candidate for adoption: R-hat_new = R_old (full transfer, the continuation treatment)

layer.source: data/processed/uncertainty/inventory.json candidateRecords (Stage44 candidate layer, earlier fit fixed to observed local-party shares)
layer.replacedCandidateShift: log-weight shift delta_c = theta_R * (R-hat_new,c - mu_f) with theta_R and mu_f = the record's own coefficients.R and trainingOnlyMeans.R; all other candidates unchanged; whole-slate renormalisation q' = q exp(delta) / sum q exp(delta)
layer.balanceMean: p' = q'_N / (q'_N + q'_L); location = Stage48 Gaussian logistic location(p', total_sd) with the unchanged Stage45 fold scales, total_sd = sqrt(seat^2 + shared^2)
layer.observation: v = log((y_N + eps)/(y_L + eps)), the unchanged Stage45 balance coordinate
layer.seats: affected seats only: every other seat is bit-identical across arms, so whole-population averages only dilute the same difference

metrics.decision: delta_CRPS: mean over affected seats of the Gaussian CRPS of v under N(location, total_sd^2), X minus Y, divided by the control's mean CRPS on the same seats
supporting: delta mean squared balance error (v - location)^2
replaced-candidate share MAE and N-L margin MAE in pp
out-of-fold R-unit squared error of R-hat_new

bootstrap.scheme: seats resampled with replacement within election, pooled equal-seat mean

decisionRule.IMPROVES: relative delta_CRPS <= -0.003 AND delta MSE <= 0 AND delta_CRPS < 0 in at least 2 of 3 elections AND bootstrap upper bound < 0
decisionRule.MIXED: anything else (for example a point improvement of 0.3% or more that fails the sign, MSE or bootstrap condition)
decisionRule.INSUFFICIENT: fewer than minimumAffectedSeats affected seats: report estimates only, no finding

findingTable.when: P vs C IMPROVES and P vs K IMPROVES
K vs C IMPROVES and P vs K is not IMPROVES
K vs C in {NEGLIGIBLE, WORSE} and P vs C in {NEGLIGIBLE, WORSE}
any other combination, or any MIXED among K vs C and P vs C

reportedNotDecisive: mean R_new minus mu_f on each scored target year and pooled (neutral on average? negative mean shift?)
pooled and per-pair OLS slope rho with seat bootstrap interval (partial transfer? rho < 1?)
S overlap: slope with and without the outgoing seat-party split (layer zS) as a control

constraints.adoption: none under any outcome; recommendation only
